name: Campus Studio
prompt:
Generate ONE polished realistic NSEDU college-discovery homepage DESIGN MOCKUP, straight-on flat website screenshot at high resolution approx 1800x2200 portrait, desktop viewport across full width, not poster, not moodboard. Visual target: mature professional consumer education platform with original tasteful brand personality and very clear user journey. User rejected both basic generic templates AND excessive shiny 3D fantasy. This must sit at a thoughtful middle: lovely composition, intentional typography, fine spacing, moderate imagery, clear content and controls. Entire page predominantly LIGHT, use no BLUE/navy/cyan, no glass sculptures, giant portals, chrome objects, lenses, ribbons, orbiting toys, handwritten slogans, excessive blur or sparkle. Subtle frost may be used ONLY on navigation or one small toolbar, never on text/content. One coherent brand accent, purposeful small secondary accents. Readable 16px-equivalent body, 48-64px-equivalent heading, realistic UI density. No absurd giant text that hides form. Hero occupies about first35% image, design4 readable sections plus CTA/footer. Precise grid, stable contrast, refined border and shadow, restrained 12-18px corners not bubbly pill everything. Header: NSEDU, Colleges, Courses, Compare, Guidance, Updates, Log in, 'Create account'. Hero must let user begin college discovery immediately; 'Find colleges' primary, 'Help me choose' secondary. Visible useful Course, City, Annual budget fields with labels. Add a marks guidance ENTRY not admission guarantees. College cards use fictional Northfield Institute, Meadow University, Central Design College, annual tuition ₹1.8L / ₹2.1L / ₹1.6L with 'Demo data' explicit, location, 'Placement data pending', Save icon and Compare checkbox. No fabricated ratings, accreditations, user counts, trusted logos, admission percentages. News examples 'Choosing a course after Class 12', 'Understanding college fees', dates 06 Oct 2026, label 'Demo article'; not fake live exam notices. AI panel sample question 'Which courses suit my interests and budget?' and action 'Explore guidance'; no fake authoritative answer. Signup invitation 'Save your shortlist. Continue later.' Footer About / Help / Privacy / Terms. Brand caption OUTSIDE webpage footer: concept ID/name, primary/background/secondary hex swatches, heading/body font name and short motion proposal. This thin caption must be accurate, legible not sidebar. No competitor names. Vary layout meaningfully, sophisticated custom art direction, never random decorations.
Concept B1 Campus Studio. Exact palette #FAF9F5 #214B3C #DCE7DF #262B27; fonts Manrope / Inter.
Composition: Hero as carefully sized THREE-COLUMN composition: left a 48px headline 'Find the college that fits you.' and clear2line support; central a large usable white search panel with stacked Course City Annual budget, green CTA; right a neatly cropped vertical real photograph of Indian students studying on a sunlit campus. Header white with thin divider. Pale warm-sage hero background with very faint structured contour line only in margin, no gradients across text. Hero photo 20% pagewidth, search30%,copy40%. Beneath a slim 3-option switchboard 'Explore colleges / Use my marks / Career guidance'. College cards have refined 16:9 photographs, superb metric alignment, quiet gray borders. Under cards a cream full-width comparison preview with2mini college rows and cost table. AI and article teasers share airy two-column lower grid. Save CTA solid green on cream with a tiny saved-shortlist product preview, white footer. Intentionally balanced modern university consumer brand..
Motion label Selected cards rise 2px; saved check 180ms. (proposal only).
